boundary: All arguments are one JSON payload p. execute(op,p) returns Result<Value>; errors preserve message and optional per-claim details. No model/provider/storage calls.

validate_schema.returns: {schema,normalization}; schema contains the same mutations as the frozen JS validator

answer_cq.returns: same as answer_plan for matching schema CQ plan

validate_input.returns: normalized input (original content unchanged, consent enforced)

validate_build_input.returns: same input; SYSTEM_BUILD_PREFLIGHT on invalid source/content hash

extraction_context.returns: original_layout_context_v1 object with preceding headings and table headers

reuse_verified_claim_spans.returns: claims[]; only an identical unique verified statement can acquire start/end

normalize_support_set.returns: support[]; missing rows maps JS undefined to wire null

structure_reference_menu.returns: {candidates,claims}; closure restoration exposed as separate restore_structure_references op

materialize_claim_evidence.returns: claims[] with exact restored evidence spans

attach_existing_query_roles.returns: item (including role_binding_resolution when existing complete patterns found)

compatibility_notes: Claim/source IDs use legacy JS stringify order, not canonical hashes.
Schema/claim normalization metadata is returned, never silently omitted.
No validateInput/runPipeline/provider orchestration migration in these three modules; those adapters remain owned by root.
No learning validateExtension implementation here; owned by learning module.
Struct menu opaque IDs are scoped to the supplied local menu, not global aliases.
Rust CORE_ASSERTION is the transport carrier for Node ERR_ASSERTION; CORE_TYPE_ERROR maps to native TypeError without code.
Only Node deepStrictEqual generated multi-line diff rendering is not duplicated: normalize_schema_envelope keeps the same stable Chinese error prefix; raw comparison is retained.

create_catalog.returns: capabilities_v1 catalog including legacy IDs/signatures/task hash

legacy_mutation_contract.validate_schema: Mutate supplied schema (including delete/normalize nested fields), append normalization array, return same schema identity in Node wrapper.
legacy_mutation_contract.validate_structure_selection: Mutate raw.items in place to returned normalized items.
legacy_mutation_contract.validate_structure_audit: Mutate raw.items and items in place to returned normalized items.
legacy_mutation_contract.attach_existing_query_roles: Mutate item in place to returned item.
legacy_mutation_contract.validate_structure_intent: No raw mutation; returns mapped requirements, ATTRIBUTE gets a new normalized object.
legacy_mutation_contract.normalize_schema_envelope: Clone schema from raw, do not mutate raw.
legacy_mutation_contract.other_pure_operations: No mutation of caller arguments unless explicitly listed.
